title: So let me get this straight, you're going to replace all workers with AGI soon but need to rely on ads for revenue?
summary: [OpenAI] The money-losing startup plans to spend more than $1 trillion on artificial intelligence infrastructure by 2030, but has not given details on how it plans to fund it.Ads will be tested with users on the company's free tier and the lower-priced Go plan that it is now expanding globally, OpenAI said on FridayAds won't affect ChatGPT answers or share user data with marketershttps://www.reuters.com/business/openai-begin-testing-ads-chatgpts-free-go-tiers-2026-01-16/OpenAI has gone from "replacing most jobs in 6 months" to needing to rely on ads despite obscene levels of investor support and many active subscriptions. Oh how the mighty have fallen.At the same time companies like Salesforce who's CEO announced they "have to pivot the whole company to agents" now admit that they were "too optimistic" and privately admit their strategy led to declining service quality, higher complaint volumes, and internal firefighting to stabilize operations.It seems like the AI hype train is meeting reality in 2026.submitted by/u/YeahBuddy5000[link][comments]
